scope: AIC Markdown functionality implemented by standard-notes-aic and aic-notes

status.currentFacts: Entrypoints and verification paths describe the current working trees. The aic-notes/vendor copies are distribution artifacts and are not independent feature owners.
status.approvedDirection: Maintain one stable registry of user-visible features, shared runtime capabilities, and host adapters.
status.reviewPending: Reviewers must confirm feature boundaries and close the declared coverage gaps before treating this registry as exhaustive.

hosts.shared-core: Canonical reusable editor behavior owned by standard-notes-aic/src/core
hosts.pwa: Device-local portable file and folder Notes app

coveragePolicy: Every canonical src .ts/.js/.css file and every aic-notes src or vendor/markdown .js/.css adapter file must appear in at least one feature sourceFiles array. Distributed aic-notes/vendor/aic-editor-core copies are excluded because their canonical owners are standard-notes-aic/src/core.

features.purpose: Open plain Markdown files and folders in the PWA, edit connected original files through one acknowledged save owner and keep browser snapshots secondary. Choose a disk destination for new files. Remember handles locally, reread originals before editing and reject external changes or deleted files without recreating them. Use the shared Markdown/AIC syntax, masked fields, SVG actions, compact mobile drawer and connected file tree. Folder traversal excludes node_modules, .git and .gitignore/.ignore rules, yields in bounded batches and retains committed results. No application encryption, password setup, encrypted import/export or legacy conversion is provided. File protection and synchronization belong to the selected storage or host; Standard Notes retains its own account services. Unsupported filesystem browsers offer explicit copies. Workspace removal disconnects without deleting original files. Update activation waits for acknowledged saves.

Use browser-owned local inference to fix grammar or improve selected prose, protecting code, links, properties and secret fences. Apply a reviewed suggestion as one undoable edit only while the original document and selection remain current.

Publish bilingual terms, the existing privacy policy, release history, installation instructions and a document-authoring How to at aic.dzyha.com. Serve the offline documents at clean URLs and repair redirected HTML in previous shell caches without changing note storage or forcing app-update activation.

Verify exact release packages before browser or VS Code marketplace submission, and propose reviewed updates of the canonical editor core with real commit provenance. Store and repository access must be configured before activation.
Compose CodeMirror, document switching, host save callbacks, access state, theme refresh, and teardown.
Provide Markdown parsing, nested fenced-language support, syntax highlighting, and reveal decorations.

Render headings, smaller italic and quote text, softly shaded quote blocks with a side rule, short centered horizontal rules, lists, links, code fences, and other structured Markdown previews with readable spacing without replacing source truth. Code previews retain full content height and independent horizontal scrolling while vertical wheel and touch gestures chain to the document, including previews inside details.

Provide one always-compact Standard Notes/browser toolbar with direct strike, link, bullet, ordered and task-list actions while keyboard, Markdown and slash commands own the omitted formatting operations; also preserve list continuation, indentation and one-operation undo boundaries.
Render and toggle Markdown task checkboxes with keyboard, read-only, stale-control, and ARIA safeguards.
Open or copy safe external links and route verified local links through the owning host.
Render language-aware fenced-code cards with copy/edit/cut controls while preserving unsupported source. Cut copies the complete Markdown block before removing it.
Render tables, copy or cut the complete Markdown block, insert and reorder rows or columns, and edit one cell through a bounded popover.

Parse and render details accordions with readable wrapping titles, consistent source actions, and inset nested previews inside a continuous parent boundary while retaining whole-block cut, links, tasks, comments, and open state.

Parse and render independently typed pipe values, including explicit one-time states, inside the single bounded aic document while preserving retired YAML Properties as raw Markdown without conversion.

Parse and render bounded AIC credential blocks with masking, independently scoped field/section/block copy, whole-block cut, add, delete, filtering, diagnostics, responsive whole-item wrapping, and exact-source reordering. Labels and typed values use natural width and wrap as complete items before text breaks; passwords use compact lock-only copy targets, short card/TOTP values stay intact, and creation controls continue the final value. Larger section headings, neutral group backgrounds and subtle alternating gray row surfaces distinguish the hierarchy. Icon-only password, section and block copy targets show temporary success checkmarks or failure crosses while keeping stable accessible action names and live feedback. Leaving block source edit or whole-note source mode stably sorts labelled rows in natural case-insensitive order within each section, with unlabelled rows last; exact authored rows, value order and section order are preserved. Section copy preserves type and masking markers. Cut removes source only after clipboard success.

Handle card parts, password generation for every empty editable secret part regardless of label or width, with responsive options and read-only guards, TOTP derivation, QR parsing, and recovery-code state under explicit security limits.
Convert recognized Authenticator JSON into bounded security blocks as an explicit undoable draft action with host save acknowledgement.

Edit Mermaid as source with a live preview, copy or cut the complete fence, intrinsic-size previews that shrink to fit with full content height and no internal scrolling, cancellation, and stale-result isolation.
Offer grouped slash templates and placeholder navigation for pages, sections, assurance, references, data, diagrams, and primitive content.
Track dirty drafts, isolate note identity, centralize explicit/focus/action saves, process exact acknowledgements, retain failures, and retire stale async work.
Recognize AIC agentic note markers and shared note-contract metadata without activating external workflows itself.

Define the shared component IDs, BEM class application, button factory with decorative SVG masks and primary action tokens, left-aligned menu rows and subtle section headings, geometry tokens, and additive migration surface used by host adapters. Indicate unsaved changes on the save button with a soft pulse and static reduced-motion accent, preserving the document background and text colors.

Build one short inert local editor guide, enabled by the shared editor by default and explicitly suppressed when the browser panel owns its trigger, while each host owns popover placement, focus, Escape handling, and disposal.
Translate Standard Notes component contexts into snapshots and guarded save targets with lock, identity, timeout, and disposal checks.
Run the editor as a development demo with plaintext localStorage persistence; it is not a credential-safe production host.

Edit a selected plain .md file or a folder of Markdown files directly. The browser worker serializes mutations, checks original bytes and revisions before writes and reports On disk only after acknowledgement. Folder .aic/links.json records URL/scope/path metadata separately from Markdown content. Existing unassociated files open without navigation; explicit linking associates a file with the active URL. Local handle bindings and acknowledged plain draft checkpoints survive reload; recovery exports copies and never replays into deleted files. No passwords, crypto, encrypted backup or legacy conversion are part of AIC. Folder scans publish inspected/found/loaded counts and bounded filename summaries, race each read against cancellation and a 30-second deadline, retain safe partial results, and ignore late results. Ordinary loads use the current observation; Refresh folder explicitly rescans. Open panels retain live native source handles independently of worker lifetime. Permission status distinguishes read and write grants; reconnect requests the retained handle from a user gesture and never probes a slow directory before returning.

Create on first edit, save, export, copy, and delete exact-URL page notes while retaining failed local drafts. Pin a saved note while browsing and add deduplicated active-page related links atomically when typing. Focused Current/Shared/Global tabs expose one scope at a time through an acknowledged save barrier. File status stays unsaved through pending writes, including undo compensation, and settles after disk acknowledgement. Pending snapshots feed the plain recovery owner until that acknowledgement; restored copies require explicit export or confirmed dismissal and never recreate deleted notes. New notes and deleted-note placeholders start as empty Markdown, with no automatic AIC block. Untouched blank pages create no record. Opening, restoring and refreshing sources show stable live progress controls outside the inert editor. Use found notes stops the scan. The file tree mounts folders lazily, pages 100 rows per level and searches every indexed note. Permission recovery preserves the current draft, selection and source identity, rejects stale status adoption and reports success only after ready/write access. File-backed save acknowledgements use opaque content revision tokens with exact identity and submitted-text checks. A remembered unavailable source offers one Continue action after its native handle is warm; fresh setup offers Open folder and Open file, with New file and source changes in More. Reconnect is shown only when needed. An explicit Open AIC in tab fallback shares the source, and returning focus can resume a grant without repicking. Scope actions target only the visible document.

Store one exact-origin Shared Markdown file separately from Current. Shared and Global mount the same AicEditor immediately, accept ordinary Markdown mixed with AIC blocks and preserve shared masking, copying and undo. Focused scope tabs use one acknowledged save barrier; there is no preview-only or Edit/Done gate. Empty documents remain blank and untouched placeholders create no file. File-backed revisions are opaque equality tokens: clean external observations can move numerically either way, while dirty drafts retain text and report conflicts for changed identities or tokens. Reloads overtaken by a local save acknowledgement are discarded and reread; non-file protocols retain sequential revision validation.

Keep one Global Markdown file per selected folder, available without an active page. Reuse the direct AicEditor and revisioned draft owner with ordinary Markdown and AIC syntax. Global stays selected across browser page changes; the visible path and Download copy action follow the active scope. Scope transitions wait for acknowledged saves and preserve failed drafts. File-backed revisions are opaque equality tokens: clean external observations can move numerically either way, while dirty drafts retain text and report conflicts for changed identities or tokens. Reloads overtaken by a local save acknowledgement are discarded and reread; non-file protocols retain sequential revision validation.
Project saved metadata-only page ancestors from the exact origin and strict URL path into a compact root-to-current navigation chain.

Show saved notes in a compact connected domain/path tree with native disclosure groups, shared SVG icons and bounded safe labels. Retain recent metadata only for pages with meaningful saved notes, omit unrelated browsing history, and open known stored destinations without changing exact URLs.

Capture the explicitly selected current page content or selection, sanitize it into Markdown, resolve safe links, and append page or file content after permission and navigation-race checks; shared outline icons distinguish page capture, file import and file export in the browser header; native paste remains editor-owned.

Export current or recovered Markdown copies explicitly without altering the original files. Imported Markdown uses the existing editor save owner. App-level encrypted backups and legacy conversion are removed.

Own side-panel context, trusted message boundaries, private-window consent, visibility teardown and stale async cancellation. The compact header contains Notes and More options. Named file/folder, pin, capture, Markdown transfer and help actions use left-aligned SVG rows. Source changes retain pending drafts; no password or Lock gate.

Register commands, views, editors, nesting defaults and lifecycle ownership in desktop and browser extension hosts from one entrypoint. Bundle a Node-free browser host using Web Crypto, UTF-8 encoders and workspace.fs; retain TextDocument save/undo ownership and validate workspace-contained virtual URIs and provider write capability.

Map files, folders, and workspace roots to canonical .note.md sidecars and memory-only placeholders without note-of-note recursion. Default new files and placeholders contain zero bytes; explicitly configured templates are preserved.

Host Markdown in a custom editor with UTF-16 change synchronization, stale-generation reset, undo/redo delegation, source/link routing, clipboard, and edit leases. Show Current, nearest Shared folder note, and Global project note through the shared scope tabs; preserve the original Current anchor and each native document owner. Show the same compact file location/save status as browser and PWA, retaining the host resource URI/provider and acknowledged TextDocument save ownership.

Follow or pin the active source's sidecar, show the nearest existing parent for an active note, preserve drafts, and provide explicit source/target navigation. Scope tabs open only existing related notes and preserve the original source anchor across save-gated navigation. Constrain the linked editor to the active panel height so long notes scroll inside CodeMirror and the footer remains visible.

Resolve linked-note relationships and source navigation, keep the compact header free of duplicated file dates, and optionally configure ordinary Explorer nesting without an extension-specific tree. Reject saves of deleted existing Markdown files and linked notes while retaining their drafts; genuine untitled files and new note placeholders can still be created.
Insert a deduplicated source-selection reference into the live linked-note draft and reopen verified local source ranges.
Confirm and move one sidecar or a selected folder's indexed sidecars to Trash, with an explicit permanent fallback only when necessary.
Expose the shared slash catalog in native and untitled Markdown while disabling it in code and read-only contexts.

Expose bundled agent instructions and enable a trusted workspace handoff without executing AIC or changing global configuration. Discover and search file, folder and project .note.md sidecars for context, ready answers, decisions and previews; treat their content as evidence within instruction precedence and preserve owner-authored notes unless editing is explicitly requested.
Remove retired authentication/sync state exactly once and verify shared-core integrity, packaging contents, checksums, licenses, and release boundaries.

Bundle one agent-neutral Markdown instruction guide in every extension without requiring a separate AIC executable or config folder. Reference the current DDK writing method: establish the reader and next action, answer necessary questions by meaning, and stop at sufficient detail while preserving AIC Markdown and typed blocks. Discover and search file, folder and project .note.md sidecars for context, ready answers, decisions and previews; treat their content as evidence within instruction precedence and preserve owner-authored notes unless editing is explicitly requested.

coverageGaps: The registry is source- and test-derived, not runtime instrumentation; dynamically generated control variants may still need finer component entries.

Authenticated Standard Notes desktop/mobile behavior, live VS Code remote or virtual workspaces, Chromium store packaging, and cross-platform assistive-technology behavior are not exhaustively verified by the listed automated tests.
Build, release, provenance, license, and deployment mechanics are represented as adapter/release features but are not decomposed into every script flag or CI job.
Vendor copies under aic-notes/vendor are intentionally references to the canonical shared owner and are not independently enumerated.
